4. First pass: app crashed with `UnsatisfiedLinkError` on `nativeResolveRef` the moment I navigated to Timeline. Traced it: `KernelBridgeRefs.kt` declares `nativeResolveRef`/`nativeReleaseRef` externs, but `nmp-chirp-android-ffi` never implemented the JNI side — a genuinely **pre-existing, never-before-exercised Chirp bug**. It only crashed now because a card was *finally* about to render and mount a `NostrAvatar`, which calls `resolveProfile` → `nativeResolveRef`. Every prior test had 0 cards, so this dead code path never fired.
5. Fixed it: the generic C-ABI (`nmp_app_resolve_ref`/`nmp_app_release_ref`) already existed and already backs iOS's equivalent calls — I just added the missing JNI wrappers in `claims.rs`, mirroring the existing `nativeClaimEvent`/`nativeReleaseEvent` pattern. Confirmed the symbols now link (`nm -D` shows both exported).
6. Reinstalled, redid the full sign-in → Timeline flow: **rev 26 · 3 cards**, all of B's notes rendering with content/timestamps/relay-provenance, no crash, account stable. Confirmed reproducibly across repeated checks.
